summary.text: J.J. Singh is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 26, which covers part of Loudoun County.
J.J. Singh has been a member since January 13, 2025.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, J.J. Singh was born in Fairfax, Virginia.
J.J. Singh studied at the University of Virginia (BA, 2002), Harvard Business School (MBA, 2010), and the Harvard Kennedy School of Government (MPA, 2010).
J.J. Singh's listed memberships and affiliations include the National Peace Corps Association, the Jekyll Island Foundation, and Ascendus.
The profile lists Jessica Lewis as J.J. Singh's spouse.
The House profile lists J.J. Singh's committee assignments as Privileges and Elections, Communications, Technology and Innovation, and Labor and Commerce.
